record.question: In a School Management Committee, 25% of its members comprise of:
options: one third members from amongst the elected members of the central university
one third members from amongst the elected members from the ruling political party
one third members from amongst the elected members of the local church, mosque or temple
one third from amongst local educationists / children in the school
record.explanation: The 25% SMC component is drawn from local educationists/children in the school.
